summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K reporting a $4 million research grant from The Vijay and Marie Goradia Charitable Foundation to extend Part 1 of the Phase 2 VacSYn trial of ACI-7104 in early Parkinson's disease. The filing is a routine disclosure of a grant, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is involved. The grant supports extending long-term safety and efficacy assessment for an additional 2 years. Final Part 1 data are expected in H2 2026.
